info.title: Innostes ERP API
info.description:
Backend REST API for **Innostes ERP**, an enterprise resource planning platform.

### Conventions
* **Identifiers**: All resource identifiers are RFC 4122 UUID v4 strings.
* **Timestamps**: All date-time fields follow ISO 8601 representation in UTC (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).
* **Audit Trail**: Every domain entity contains `id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `deleted_at`, and `deleted_by`.
* **Soft Deletes**: Deletion operations perform soft-deletion. Soft-deleted records are excluded from default queries and list views unless `include_deleted=true` is supplied.
* **Pagination**: Collection list operations use zero-based `offset` and positive `limit` query parameters, returning a standardized `Page` object `{items, total, offset, limit}`.
* **Errors**: Standard RFC 7807-compliant responses with `{detail, code?}` payloads. Input validation failures emit standard HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity payloads.

### Security & Authentication
* **Bearer Tokens**: Authenticated requests must present `Authorization: Bearer <token>` carrying either a 30-minute JWT access token issued by `/auth/login` or a permanent Personal API Key (`inno_live_...`).
* **Refresh Tokens**: 7-day single-use rotating refresh tokens are managed via HttpOnly secure cookies or `/auth/refresh`.
* **Multi-Tenancy**: Tenant-scoped operations accept the `X-Tenant-ID` header.

get.description:
Service name, environment, status, and the list of loaded modules.

Public endpoint. Returns service identification and loaded feature module metadata.

Public endpoint. Supplies non-sensitive deployment information to client applications.

Public endpoint. Returns **200** with `status: pass` when the database responds,
otherwise **503** with `status: fail`.

post.description:
Authenticates credentials and issues short-lived JWT and refresh tokens.

Public endpoint. Sets secure HttpOnly cookies for web browsers and returns
bearer credentials for programmatic API callers.

Rotates a single-use refresh token and issues fresh access credentials.

Public endpoint. Detects reuse attempts, invalidating compromised session
families if reuse occurs.

Dispatches password reset instructions with anti-enumeration protection.

Public endpoint. Always returns a 200 confirmation notice regardless of
whether the email is registered in the system.

Resets account credentials using a single-use signed reset token.

Public endpoint. Enforces SOC 2 historical password reuse prevention and
revokes all active sessions upon successful reset.

Updates password for the currently authenticated user.

Requires Bearer authentication. Verifies existing credentials before
applying the update and rotating active sessions.

Revokes active refresh tokens and clears authentication cookies.

Requires Bearer authentication. Optionally revokes all active sessions
across all client devices when logout_all is true.

get.description:

Requires Bearer authentication. Decrypts PII fields (email, mobile) for
the authorized user.

Lists programmatic API keys registered for the current organisation.

Requires Bearer authentication. Omits secret hashes and reveals key
metadata and permission scopes.

post.description:
Create a new tenant (customer organisation).

Requires Bearer authentication. If a valid bearer token is sent, its user is
recorded in `created_by` and `updated_by`. Returns **409** if the slug is already taken.

get.description:
List tenants with pagination, newest first.

Requires Bearer authentication. Soft-deleted tenants are hidden unless
`include_deleted=true` is requested.

200.description: One page of tenants, newest first.

get.description:
Get one tenant organisation by unique id.

Requires Bearer authentication. Soft-deleted tenants return 404.

schema.description: Unique identifier of the tenant organisation.

patch.description:
Change tenant organisation fields. Only sent fields are modified.

Requires Bearer authentication. The calling user is recorded in `updated_by`.
Soft-deleted tenants return 404; restore them first.

delete.description:
Soft-delete a tenant organisation.

Requires Bearer authentication. The tenant is hidden from standard lists
but retained in the database. Sets `deleted_at` and `deleted_by`. Undo with
`POST /tenants/{tenant_id}/restore`.

post.description:
Bring back a soft-deleted tenant organisation.

Requires Bearer authentication. Clears `deleted_at` and `deleted_by`.
Calling on an active tenant is harmless and idempotent.
